b'# tinydl

A simple command-line downloader tool.

## Usage

```bash
tinydl [-h] [-o OUTPUT] [-q] url
```

## Options

| Option | Short | Description |
|--------|-------|-------------|
| `url` | - | what to download (required, positional) |
| `-o` | `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q` | `--quiet` | no progress output |

## Examples

```bash
# Download from URL to stdout
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt

# Download to a file
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -o output.txt

# Download silently (no byte count output)
tinydl https://example.com/file.txt -q
```
'
